sections.content: You know reported speech from B1 Unit 13 and the phrases of the last three lessons (*quiso decir que*, *lo que quiero decir es que*). Here you combine them to tell an awkward conversation: what was said, what was meant and how you interpreted it.

items.spanish: Pensé que estaba preocupada, pero explicó que estaba cansada.
items.english: I thought she was worried, but she explained that she was tired.
What did he mean by that?

items.spanish: Lo que quería decir era que necesitábamos hablar.
items.english: What she meant was that we needed to talk.

sections.content: When explaining an interaction, distinguish what was said, what was meant and how it was interpreted.
